positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
■ Researched Actuate BIRT, worked with team to implement cross-filterable charts for Big Data application
■ Worked with team to build web-based seating reservation system using HTML, CSS, JS and embedded devices (Raspberry Pi) interfaced with biometric readers 
■ Worked with team to build web-based biometric access management system using AngularJS and embedded devices (Raspberry Pi + electronic locks)
■ Served as junior team lead to group of 15 interns during their internship
■ Advised group of interns (5 people) during their summer internship Android coding challenge
■ Managed Think Tank group whose purpose was to improve the overall TDP-ET program
■ Took on role of technical interviewer for new candidates to the program
■ Joined mentoring group to help new hires transition into TDP-ET

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
■ Designed and implemented Android app with a team for coding competition to allow for disaster reporting at company-owned real estate locations, won coding competition 
■ Utilized Given-When-Then/BDD requirements documentation format to translate plain text requirements

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
■ Implemented a Perl script for determining the number and type of service orders in a SQL database
■ Designed and implemented a Google Web Toolkit project to clean defunct service orders from a testing database

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
■ Designed and implemented VBA program to retrieve/sort reject data from assembly line
■ Automated daily report in Microsoft Excel using VBA

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
■ Worked with co-intern on designing a program to track reject data from assembly line in real-time
■ Conducted empirical study with co-intern to determine reject rate differences between impeller shifts
